levers.deviations: (1) Latency compensation, an addition to the plan sketch. WebRTC NS delays its output by 96 samples (6 ms) at every level (measured; 256-pt FFT on 160-sample frames). wrtc_ns therefore runs 96 extra zero samples and drops the first 96 output samples, so the output is sample-aligned with the input. Without this, the first 6 ms of every processed clip would be the primed suppressor's synthesis tail of the priming segment, and the last 6 ms of the clip would be lost. A fifth named selftest assert, [aligned] (output lag 0), guards it. The four planned asserts are unchanged. (2) [shape_finite] also runs on a 1234-sample white-noise clip, which is shorter than the 0.5 s priming window and not a multiple of 10 ms, to exercise the padding paths. (3) apm_balance sample: 200 clips (25 per class x src x lang cell = 100 bona + 100 spoof), each under both conditions. That is the plan v3's '200 + 200' runs; the v2 wording '200 bona + 200 spoof' contradicts 25 per cell. The WARN rule is applied to both the whole-clip and the low-energy measure. (4) When the lever is on, a second start-up line 'B4 APM NS selftest: PASS <values>' is printed, because the smoke check needs the selftest values printed. It does not match the header regex. (5) Level validation exists at four points: argparse choices, validate_b4_args (non-empty), the augmenter init and wrtc_ns. With the lever off the levels are still validated at parse time (argparse choices) but never read by the augmenter. (6) data.py and scripts/b4_dsp_slices.py are in the plan's file list but needed no change. The core step already wired the B4 dataset factory and built the readout, including the apm_ns verdict rules and the O3.1-O3.3 owner amendments.

equivalence_argument: With --aug_apm_p 0.0 (the default), active_levers(args) is [], so build_rtc_augmenter_b4 returns build_rtc_augmenter_b3(args) itself: the B3 object, the B3 config, describe() and meta_keys. No RTCAugmenterB4 is constructed, so _init_apm_ns never runs. b4wave.dsp_apm and pywebrtc_audio are never imported (checks imports: fresh process, sys.modules empty of both). No rng4 is created or drawn from, and --aug_apm_ns_levels is not read by the augmenter: base_args(aug_apm_ns_levels=[9]) still builds the B3 object (apm_levels_unread_when_p0). The parent numpy RNG therefore makes exactly the B2f stage and codec draws. checks data shows the train/dev datasets equal b3wave's, with 3 real clips bit-identical after load + augment + codec. No lever header line is printed (b4_header_lines == []). config.yaml rtc_augmentation is the B3 describe(), and b4_levers is []. The model is untouched (ModelSLSB3, no params added), so the forward pass and the checkpoint keys are the same. Separately, with the lever forced on, rng4 isolation holds (plan item 3): apm_p=1.0 with an identity NS gives outputs bit-identical to B3 on 200 clips without and 10 with the codec. Parent stage/codec counts are equal, and the level sequence equals default_rng([1234, pid, 0xB4]) draws (random() then integers(4) per clip). With the real NS at p=0.3, unprocessed clips are bit-identical to B3 and parent counts are equal.
open_issues: The supervisor still has to run GPU checks and the smoke: checks gpu lever_forward_backward(apm_ns) and the plan smoke bars (wrtc_ns/codec ratio, per-class rate, VRAM).

Stray cache file: `python -m py_compile ../scripts/b4_dsp_slices.py` created scripts/__pycache__/b4_dsp_slices.cpython-312.pyc. It is git-ignored (.gitignore: __pycache__) and the manifest check reports 0 violations, but the guard forbids deleting it because it is outside the write scope. Later parts should use ast.parse for scripts/.

Size: the lever code is ~190 code lines (dsp_apm 139 + augment ~40 + train ~12), close to the plan's est_loc 200. The checks add ~270 code lines vs the planned 80 (apm_balance and the per-assert value printing).

WebRTC NS removes the full level from the selftest's harmonic complex too (−6/−12/−18/−21 dB). The suppressor learns the stationary periodic signal as noise. The plan allows this ([no_gain] is one-sided). On real training clips the whole-clip removal is small: 0.6–1.7 dB mean (apm_balance).
Timing projection is noisy because ffmpeg children dominate: 1.049 and 1.012 in two runs. Both are under the 1.15 stop rule.
